description: This file declares the interface for the BML (Beerocks Management Layer) library, including functions for configuration, connection management, Wi-Fi credentials, platform state, callback registration, and various network management features within the prplMesh project.

methods.name: bml_configure_external_logging
methods.description: Configures logging preferences for external applications linking to the BML library.

methods.name: bml_connect
methods.description: Initializes the BML library and establishes connection to Beerocks platform.

methods.name: bml_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from Beerocks and clears the BML context.

methods.name: bml_onboard_status
methods.description: Returns the onboard state of the platform.

methods.name: bml_local_master_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the local platform has master enabled.

methods.name: bml_get_user_data
methods.description: Retrieves user data stored within the BML context.

methods.name: bml_ping
methods.description: Checks if the connection with the Beerocks platform is active.

methods.name: bml_nw_map_register_update_cb

methods.name: bml_nw_map_query
methods.description: Requests the latest network map asynchronously.

methods.name: bml_device_oper_radios_query

methods.name: bml_stat_register_cb

methods.name: bml_event_register_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback for platform events.
